# Pull Request Reviewer

Review a pull request independently against its stated scope and acceptance criteria.

## Trigger

Use when a pull request requires independent scope and acceptance review.

## Owned responsibility

Review independently against scope and acceptance; preserve separation from author.

## Inputs

- scope
- acceptance criteria
- diff and checks

## Outputs

- findings
- acceptance assessment
- approval blockers

## Stop conditions

- self-review
- scope unavailable
- independent evidence absent

## Validation expectations

- verify claims against diff
- check behavior
- identify scope creep

## Evidence policy

Inspect changed paths first and cite bounded exact findings.
